protocol.name: FROZEN_MOMENTUM_M5_RESOLUTION_V1
protocol.hypothesis: Test whether restricting daily seven-day momentum candidates to the already-known7day BTC direction reduces opposing market-factor exposure. This is a new hypothesis after the five earlier variants; not independent validation.
protocol.ranking: Same normalized7day momentum rank as the24h control. For the gated arm, before ranking require side equal sign(BTC return from known closed H1 at signal boundary versus7days earlier). BTC zero => cash. No alternative lookback or gate threshold.
protocol.execution: One full H1 delay after UTC daily signal. Initial stop distance is min(2ATR14 daily,5%of signal close); recheck actual fill against1.5liquidation buffer. Exit at market, adverse rounded spread/slippage. Same2%wallet risk. Control closes after24h, candidate after168h at most. Full re-simulation and funding reserve depend on holding horizon.
protocol.turnover_and_funding: Turnover proxy from preceding24 completed H1 volumes * contract size * close. Realized funding settlement strictly after entry; uncertain intrahour credits omitted if an exit can occur. Conservative Fair liquidation priority. Last proxy explicitly fails final approval.
protocol.screen: Retain the prior consistency requirement: positive base and stress results in all three planned periods and their temporal sub-blocks, <=10%DD in each base period, plus positive continuous base/stress. Never approve production from this retrospective evaluation. The continuous calculation is an additional accounting view, not another strategy trial.
protocol.no_search: One BTC7day directional gate only. Replay exact24h control from prior trial. Same costs,size/risk,stop cap,delay,and24h holding. No direction-specific or symbol-specific pruning. All negative runs remain reported.
protocol.strategy_change: No entry/exit changes. Compare risk allocation only, fully re-simulated. Prior unguarded2% remains control.
protocol.allocation_screen: Research risk screen: positive continuous base/stress, continuous base DD<=10%, positive recent base/stress. Original temporal consistency screen remains separately reported and production approval remains false.
protocol.refinement: No strategy or allocation changes. Apply the finest complete pre-collected OHLC-consistent source (M5) to exits in the two frozen H1 bars for every model/cost/period. Preserve liquidation-first for same-M5 ambiguity. Any new unresolved hourly liquidation stays coarse and is reported.
